name: ltx-2-l0
test_prompt: A cheerful small red robot with glossy metal panels walks through a sunlit botanical garden filled with colorful flowers, butterflies, and soft golden light. Smooth cinematic camera movement, detailed textures, vibrant colors, shallow depth of field, high quality.
notes: LTX-2 differs from LTX-Video on several axes: (1) it adds audio_vae/connectors/latent_upsampler/vocoder components beyond the standard text+DiT+vae pipeline, (2) tokenizer has audio preprocessor config (audio-conditioned generation), (3) outputs both video frames and audio. Lane is scaffolding only — onboarding needs a new family 'ltx_2' that handles all 7 components. The existing ltx_video family on main only covers Lightricks/LTX-Video (5 components: T5 text encoder + DiT + VAE + scheduler + tokenizer).
